cases.reason: Proposed administrative consolidation of two outbreak-reporting forms into one, affecting an estimated 59 health-department epidemiologists with no cost beyond time; paperwork revision pending OMB approval.
cases.quote: CDC requests OMB approval to combine the two previously approved forms (Form 52.12 Waterborne Disease Transmission and Form 52.13 Foodborne, Person to Person Disease Transmission, Animal Contact, Environmental Contamination, Unknown Transmission mode) previously approved under OMB Control No. 0920-1304 into one form (Form 52.14).
